q19679.en: The sign shown bans motorcycles from passing.

explain.short: The sign shows a motorbike inside a red circle, so motorcycles may not go in.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (bans passing) is exactly what this red circle does.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycles may not enter here

q19680.en: The sign shown allows motor tricycles and quadricycles to pass.

explain.short: The ban is only for motorcycles; tricycles and quadricycles are different vehicles, so they may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'tricicli e quadricicli' (three- and four-wheel light vehicles) are not motorcycles.

sceneParams.caption: Tricycles and quadricycles may pass

q19681.en: The sign shown allows cars to pass.

explain.short: Only motorcycles are banned; cars (autovetture) may drive on.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'autovetture' (cars) are not shown on the sign, so they are not banned.

sceneParams.caption: Cars may pass: only motorcycles are banned

q19682.en: The sign shown allows bicycles to pass.

explain.short: Bicycles have no engine and are not motorcycles, so they may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'biciclette' (bicycles) have two wheels, but they are not motorcycles.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles may pass: only motorcycles are banned

q19683.en: The sign shown bans motorcycles of any engine size from passing.

explain.short: The ban covers every motorcycle, small or big; there is no engine-size limit.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'di qualsiasi cilindrata' (of any engine size) is right: no size is excluded.

sceneParams.caption: All motorcycles banned, any engine size

q19684.en: The sign shown allows motorcycles to pass.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the motorbike in the red circle means motorcycles are banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'consente' (allows) is wrong: the sign forbids motorcycles.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: this sign BANS motorcycles

q19685.en: The sign shown bans all two-wheeled vehicles from passing.

explain.short: Only motorcycles are banned; bicycles and two-wheel mopeds may still pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'tutti i veicoli a due ruote' (all two-wheelers) is too much: bikes and mopeds are allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Only motorcycles: bikes and mopeds may pass

keywords.it: a tutti i veicoli a due ruote

q19686.en: The sign shown refers only to motorcycles with an engine size over 125 cc.

explain.short: The sign bans all motorcycles, also those of 125 cc or less.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'soli' (only) with 'superiore ai 125 cm3' adds a limit the sign does not have.

sceneParams.caption: All motorcycles banned, not only over 125 cc

q19687.en: The sign shown allows motorcycles fitted with a safety cell to pass.

explain.short: A motorcycle with a safety cell (a protective frame and roof) is still a motorcycle, so it is banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'dotati di cellula di sicurezza' (with a safety cell) does not create an exception.

sceneParams.caption: Safety cell or not, motorcycles are banned

q19688.en: The sign shown bans mopeds from passing.

explain.short: Mopeds (ciclomotori) are not motorcycles, so this sign does not ban them.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'ciclomotori' (mopeds, max 45 km/h) are a different category from 'motocicli'.

sceneParams.caption: Mopeds may pass: only motorcycles are banned

q19689.en: The sign shown bans motor quadricycles from passing.

explain.short: Quadricycles are four-wheel vehicles, not motorcycles, so they may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'quadricicli a motore' (small four-wheel vehicles) are not on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Quadricycles may pass: only motorcycles banned

q19690.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: A red circle is a prohibition sign; danger signs are red triangles.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'segnale di pericolo' (danger sign) is wrong: round red-bordered signs forbid something.

sceneParams.caption: It is a prohibition sign, not a danger sign

q19691.en: The sign shown requires motorcyclists to use the lane reserved for them.

explain.short: The sign forbids motorcycles; it does not send them to a special lane. Obligations are blue round signs.
explain.rule: This sign bans motorcycles of every engine size. Mopeds, bicycles, cars, tricycles and quadricycles may pass.
explain.trap: 'obbliga' (requires) is wrong: a red circle forbids, it does not order a lane.

sceneParams.caption: It bans motorcycles; no special lane

q19692.en: The sign shown bans hand-drawn vehicles from passing.

explain.short: The picture shows a person pushing a cart: vehicles moved by hand may not go in.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'veicoli a braccia' (vehicles moved by human arms) is exactly the meaning.

sceneParams.caption: No vehicles pushed or pulled by hand

q19693.en: The sign shown allows bicycles to pass.

explain.short: Only hand-drawn vehicles are banned; bicycles may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'biciclette' are pedalled, not pushed like a handcart.

sceneParams.caption: Bicycles may pass: only handcarts banned

q19694.en: The sign shown allows mopeds to pass.

explain.short: Only hand-drawn vehicles are banned; mopeds may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'ciclomotori' (mopeds) have an engine: they are not hand-drawn.

sceneParams.caption: Mopeds may pass: only handcarts banned

q19695.en: The sign shown allows cars towing a small luggage trailer to pass.

explain.short: A car with a small luggage trailer is a motor vehicle, not a hand-drawn one, so it may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'carrello-appendice' (small luggage trailer) may look like a cart, but the car pulls it, not a person.

sceneParams.caption: A car with a luggage trailer may pass

q19696.en: The sign shown bans handcarts from passing.

explain.short: A handcart (carretto a mano) is a hand-drawn vehicle, exactly what the sign shows.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'carretti a mano' (handcarts) is just another name for 'veicoli a braccia'.

sceneParams.caption: No handcarts: they are hand-drawn vehicles

q19697.en: The sign shown indicates a road reserved for street sellers.

explain.short: The sign bans handcarts; it does not reserve the road for anyone.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'riservata ai venditori ambulanti' (reserved for street sellers) is invented: a red circle forbids.

sceneParams.caption: It bans handcarts; it reserves nothing

q19698.en: The sign shown bans motor vehicles during market hours.

explain.short: The sign bans hand-drawn vehicles, at any time; motor vehicles may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'veicoli a motore' and 'ore di mercato' are both wrong: no engines, no times on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Bans handcarts at all times, not motor vehicles

q19699.en: The sign shown is a danger sign.

explain.short: A red circle is a prohibition sign; danger signs are red triangles.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'segnale di pericolo' (danger sign) is wrong: this round sign forbids handcarts.

sceneParams.caption: It is a prohibition sign, not a danger sign

q19700.en: The sign shown applies to all vehicles during market hours.

explain.short: The sign applies only to hand-drawn vehicles, and at all hours.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'per tutti i veicoli' and 'ore di mercato' are both invented.

sceneParams.caption: Only handcarts, and at all hours

q19701.en: The sign shown bans animal-drawn vehicles from passing.

explain.short: Animal-drawn vehicles have their own sign (a horse and cart); this one shows a person pushing a cart.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'trazione animale' (pulled by animals) is not 'a braccia' (by hand).

sceneParams.caption: Only hand-drawn vehicles, not animal-drawn

q19702.en: The sign shown bans a motorcycle from passing, even if it is pushed by hand.

explain.short: A motorcycle pushed by hand is still a motorcycle, not a hand-drawn vehicle, so this sign does not ban it.
explain.rule: This sign bans only vehicles pushed or pulled by hand (veicoli a braccia). All other vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'anche se spinto a braccia' (even if pushed by hand) does not turn a motorbike into a handcart.

sceneParams.caption: A pushed motorbike is not a handcart

q19703.en: The sign shown bans all motor vehicles from passing.

explain.short: The car in the red circle stands for all autoveicoli (motor vehicles with three or more wheels).
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'tutti gli autoveicoli' (all motor vehicles) is right: not only cars.

sceneParams.caption: No motor vehicles (autoveicoli) at all

q19704.en: The sign shown bans motor tricycles from passing.

explain.short: Motor tricycles are autoveicoli, so they are banned too.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'tricicli a motore' (motor tricycles) count as autoveicoli, even with only three wheels.

sceneParams.caption: Motor tricycles are banned too

q19705.en: Where the sign shown is present, motorcycles may pass.

explain.short: Motorcycles have two wheels, so they are not autoveicoli and may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'motocicli' (motorcycles) are not covered by the car symbol.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycles may pass this sign

q19706.en: Where the sign shown is present, two-wheel mopeds may pass.

explain.short: Two-wheel mopeds are not autoveicoli, so they may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'a due ruote' (two-wheel) matters: two-wheelers are outside this ban.

sceneParams.caption: Two-wheel mopeds may pass

q19707.en: The sign shown bans motor quadricycles from passing.

explain.short: Motor quadricycles are autoveicoli, so they are banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'quadricicli a motore' (small four-wheel vehicles) count as autoveicoli.

sceneParams.caption: Motor quadricycles are banned too

q19708.en: Where the sign shown is present, vehicles without an engine may pass.

explain.short: The ban is only for motor vehicles; bicycles and carts without an engine may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'sprovvisti di motore' (without an engine) means not autoveicoli.

sceneParams.caption: Vehicles without an engine may pass

q19709.en: Where the sign shown is present, motor quadricycles may pass.

explain.short: Motor quadricycles are autoveicoli, so they are banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'permesso' (allowed) is wrong: quadricycles are covered by the ban.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: quadricycles are banned here

q19710.en: The sign shown bans only non-catalytic cars from passing.

explain.short: The sign bans ALL motor vehicles, with or without a catalytic converter.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'sole' (only) with 'non catalizzate' (without catalytic converter) is invented.

sceneParams.caption: All motor vehicles banned, not just old cars

q19711.en: Where the sign shown is present, cars used as taxis may pass.

explain.short: A taxi is still a car, so it is banned like every autoveicolo.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'servizio di taxi' (taxi service) does not create an exception.

sceneParams.caption: Taxis are cars: they are banned too

q19712.en: Where the sign shown is present, all motor tricycles may pass.

explain.short: Motor tricycles are autoveicoli, so they are banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'tutti i tricicli' (all tricycles) is wrong: they are covered by the ban.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: motor tricycles are banned here

q19713.en: Where the sign shown is present, buses may pass.

explain.short: Buses are autoveicoli, so they are banned by this sign.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'autobus' is not drawn, but the car symbol covers all autoveicoli.

sceneParams.caption: Buses are banned too: they are autoveicoli

q19714.en: Where the sign shown is present, lorries may pass.

explain.short: Lorries are autoveicoli, so they are banned by this sign.
explain.rule: This sign bans all autoveicoli, including tricycles and quadricycles. Motorcycles, two-wheel mopeds and non-motor vehicles may pass.
explain.trap: 'autocarri' (lorries) are not drawn, but the car symbol covers them.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries are banned too: they are autoveicoli

q19715.en: The sign shown indicates that buses are banned from passing.

explain.short: The bus inside a red circle means buses may not go in.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'divieto di transito' (ban on passing) is the meaning of every red circle.

sceneParams.caption: No buses

q19716.en: Where the sign shown is present, cars may pass.

explain.short: Only buses are banned; cars may drive on.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'autovetture' (cars) are not on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Cars may pass: only buses are banned

q19717.en: Where the sign shown is present, lorries may pass.

explain.short: Only buses are banned; lorries carry goods, not passengers, so they may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'autocarri' (lorries) are not buses.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries may pass: only buses are banned

q19718.en: Where the sign shown is present, motorcycles may pass.

explain.short: Only buses are banned; motorcycles may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'motocicli' (motorcycles) are not on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycles may pass: only buses are banned

q19719.en: Where the sign shown is present, campers may pass.

explain.short: A camper (autocaravan) is not a bus, so it may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'autocaravan' (motorhome) is big, but it is not a bus.

sceneParams.caption: Campers may pass: only buses are banned

q19720.en: The sign shown also bans buses with a laden mass under 3.5 tonnes.

explain.short: The sign bans every bus, small or large; there is no mass limit.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also) is right: even light buses under 3.5 t are banned.

sceneParams.caption: All buses banned, even under 3.5 t

q19721.en: Where the sign shown is present, tourist buses may pass.

explain.short: Tourist buses are buses, so they are banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'turistici' (tourist) does not create an exception.

sceneParams.caption: Tourist buses are banned too

q19722.en: The sign shown marks a lane reserved for buses.

explain.short: A red circle forbids buses; it does not mark a bus lane.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'corsia riservata' (reserved lane) is the opposite idea: here buses are banned.

sceneParams.caption: It bans buses; it is not a bus lane

q19723.en: The sign shown announces a parking area for tourist buses.

explain.short: The sign bans buses; it does not announce any parking area.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia un'area di sosta' (announces a parking area) is wrong: a red circle forbids.

sceneParams.caption: It bans buses; no bus parking here

q19724.en: Where the sign shown is present, school buses may pass.

explain.short: School buses are buses, so they are banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'scuolabus' (school bus) does not create an exception.

sceneParams.caption: School buses are banned too

q19725.en: The sign shown bans campers from passing.

explain.short: Campers (autocaravan) are not buses, so they may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'autocaravan' (motorhomes) are not buses.

sceneParams.caption: Campers may pass: only buses are banned

q19726.en: The sign shown is valid only on working days.

explain.short: The sign is valid every day; only an extra panel could limit days or times.
explain.rule: This sign bans every bus, of any type or mass. Cars, lorries, motorcycles and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'solo nei giorni feriali' (only on working days) is invented: no panel says so.

sceneParams.caption: Valid every day, not only working days

q19727.en: The sign shown bans vehicles used to carry goods with a laden mass over 3.5 tonnes.

explain.short: A lorry with no number on the sign means goods vehicles over 3.5 t are banned.
explain.rule: Without a number, this sign bans goods vehicles over 3.5 t laden mass. Buses and campers are not affected.
explain.trap: 'superiore a 3,5 tonnellate' (over 3.5 tonnes) is the limit when no number is shown.

sceneParams.caption: Goods vehicles over 3.5 t banned

q19728.en: Where the sign shown is present, buses with a total mass over 3.5 tonnes may pass.

explain.short: Buses carry people, not goods, so this sign does not concern them.
explain.rule: Without a number, this sign bans goods vehicles over 3.5 t laden mass. Buses and campers are not affected.
explain.trap: 'autobus' carry people: the ban is only for 'trasporto di cose' (goods).

sceneParams.caption: Buses may pass: the ban is for goods vehicles

q19729.en: Where the sign shown is present, a camper with a laden mass over 3.5 tonnes may pass.

explain.short: A camper (autocaravan) is not a goods vehicle, so it may pass even if heavy.
explain.rule: Without a number, this sign bans goods vehicles over 3.5 t laden mass. Buses and campers are not affected.
explain.trap: 'autocaravan' is heavy but carries people, not goods.

sceneParams.caption: Heavy campers may pass: not goods vehicles

q19730.en: The sign shown may have an extra panel showing a different mass allowed to pass.

explain.short: Without a number the limit is 3.5 t, but an extra panel can set a different mass.
explain.rule: Without a number, this sign bans goods vehicles over 3.5 t laden mass. Buses and campers are not affected.
explain.trap: 'pannello integrativo' (extra panel under the sign) can change the mass value.

sceneParams.caption: An extra panel can set a different mass

q19731.en: The sign shown bans a lorry with a laden mass of 3 tonnes from passing.

explain.short: 3 tonnes is under the 3.5 t limit, so this lorry may pass.
explain.rule: Without a number, this sign bans goods vehicles over 3.5 t laden mass. Buses and campers are not affected.
explain.trap: 'pari a 3 tonnellate' (equal to 3 tonnes) is below 3.5 t.

sceneParams.caption: A 3 t lorry may pass: limit is over 3.5 t

q19732.en: The sign shown bans all lorries with a closed van body from passing.

explain.short: Only goods vehicles over 3.5 t are banned; light vans may pass, whatever their body.
explain.rule: Without a number, this sign bans goods vehicles over 3.5 t laden mass. Buses and campers are not affected.
explain.trap: 'tutti' (all) is wrong: the type of body does not matter, only the mass.

sceneParams.caption: Only over 3.5 t: body type does not matter

q19733.en: Where the sign shown is present, all lorries with an open body may pass.

explain.short: Lorries over 3.5 t are banned, also with an open body.
explain.rule: Without a number, this sign bans goods vehicles over 3.5 t laden mass. Buses and campers are not affected.
explain.trap: 'tutti' (all) is wrong: a heavy open lorry is still banned.

sceneParams.caption: Over 3.5 t banned, open body or not

q19734.en: The sign shown bans vehicles over 3.5 tonnes used to carry people.

explain.short: The sign is for goods vehicles; vehicles for people (buses, campers) may pass.
explain.rule: Without a number, this sign bans goods vehicles over 3.5 t laden mass. Buses and campers are not affected.
explain.trap: 'trasporto di persone' (carrying people) is wrong: the ban is for goods.

sceneParams.caption: Only goods vehicles: people carriers may pass

q19735.en: Where the sign shown is present, road trains over 3.5 tonnes not used to carry people may pass.

explain.short: A road train (autotreno) that does not carry people carries goods, so over 3.5 t it is banned.
explain.rule: Without a number, this sign bans goods vehicles over 3.5 t laden mass. Buses and campers are not affected.
explain.trap: 'non adibiti al trasporto di persone' (not carrying people) means goods: exactly what is banned.

sceneParams.caption: Heavy goods road trains are banned

keywords.it: non adibiti al trasporto di persone

q19736.en: Where the sign shown is present, campers may pass.

explain.short: Campers carry people, not goods, so this ban does not concern them.
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'autocaravan' (motorhomes) are not goods vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Campers may pass: ban is for goods vehicles

q19737.en: Where the sign shown is present, buses may pass.

explain.short: Buses carry people, not goods, so this ban does not concern them.
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'autobus' carry people: the ban is for goods vehicles only.

sceneParams.caption: Buses may pass: ban is for goods vehicles

q19738.en: The sign shown bans lorries with a laden mass over 6.5 tonnes from passing.

explain.short: The 6.5 t on the lorry is the limit: heavier lorries may not pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'superiore a 6,5 tonnellate' (over 6.5 tonnes) matches the number on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Lorries over 6.5 t banned

q19739.en: Where the sign shown is present, vehicles used to carry goods with a total mass equal to or below the one shown on the sign may pass.

explain.short: Only goods vehicles heavier than 6.5 t are banned; those up to 6.5 t may pass.
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'pari o inferiore' (equal to or below) is allowed: the ban starts above the number.

sceneParams.caption: Goods vehicles up to 6.5 t may pass

q19740.en: Where the sign shown is present, lorries are banned if the registration document shows a laden mass over 6.5 tonnes.

explain.short: The mass that counts is the laden mass written in the registration document (carta di circolazione).
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'carta di circolazione' (registration document) is where you read the mass that counts.

sceneParams.caption: Registered mass over 6.5 t: banned

q19741.en: Where the sign shown is present, lorries with a total mass of 7.5 tonnes may pass.

explain.short: 7.5 t is more than 6.5 t, so these lorries are banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: '7,5 tonnellate' is over the 6.5 t limit.

sceneParams.caption: 7.5 t is over 6.5 t: banned

q19742.en: The sign shown bans vehicles over 6.5 tonnes used to carry people.

explain.short: The sign is for goods vehicles; buses and campers may pass at any mass.
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'trasporto di persone' (carrying people) is wrong: the ban is for goods.

sceneParams.caption: Only goods vehicles: people carriers may pass

q19743.en: Where the sign shown is present, special-use motor vehicles over 6.5 tonnes may pass.

explain.short: Heavy special-use vehicles (e.g. crane or tow trucks) are covered by the ban too.
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'uso speciale' (special use) gives no exception over 6.5 t.

sceneParams.caption: Special-use vehicles over 6.5 t are banned

q19744.en: The sign shown announces a public weighbridge nearby.

explain.short: The sign bans heavy goods vehicles; it does not announce a weighbridge.
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'pesa pubblica' (public weighbridge) is invented: the 6.5 t is a limit, not a scale.

sceneParams.caption: A mass limit, not a weighbridge

q19745.en: The sign shown bans buses with a total mass over 10 tonnes from passing.

explain.short: Buses carry people, so this goods-vehicle ban does not concern them at any mass.
explain.rule: This sign bans goods vehicles whose laden mass is over the value shown (6.5 t). Lighter goods vehicles, buses and campers may pass.
explain.trap: 'autobus' and '10 tonnellate' are both wrong: no buses, and the limit is 6.5 t.

sceneParams.caption: Buses may pass: only goods vehicles banned

q19746.en: The sign shown may have an extra panel allowing trailers with a mass not over the one shown on the panel.

explain.short: An extra panel can allow light trailers, up to the mass it shows.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'pannello' (extra panel) can soften the ban for light trailers.

sceneParams.caption: A panel can allow light trailers

q19747.en: The sign shown bans road trains from passing.

explain.short: A road train (autotreno) is a lorry towing a trailer, exactly what the sign shows.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'autotreni' (lorry plus trailer) are the typical case of this ban.

sceneParams.caption: No road trains (lorry + trailer)

q19748.en: Where the sign shown is present, a motor vehicle towing a small luggage trailer may pass.

explain.short: A carrello-appendice (small luggage trailer) is not a real trailer, so it is allowed.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'carrello-appendice' is not a 'rimorchio' for this sign.

sceneParams.caption: A small luggage trailer is allowed

q19749.en: The sign shown bans motor vehicles towing a trailer from passing.

explain.short: The lorry with a trailer stands for every motor vehicle that tows a trailer.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'trainanti un rimorchio' (towing a trailer) is the exact meaning.

sceneParams.caption: No motor vehicles towing a trailer

q19750.en: Where the sign shown is present, articulated buses may pass.

explain.short: An articulated bus (autosnodato) is one bendy vehicle, not a vehicle towing a trailer.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'autosnodati' (bendy buses) look long, but they do not tow a trailer.

sceneParams.caption: Articulated buses may pass: no trailer

q19751.en: Where the sign shown is present, a car towing a caravan may pass.

explain.short: A caravan is a trailer, so a car towing it is banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'caravan' is a trailer: the ban is not only for lorries.

sceneParams.caption: A car with a caravan is banned

q19752.en: The sign shown applies only to vehicles used to carry goods.

explain.short: The ban covers every motor vehicle with a trailer, also cars with a caravan.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is wrong: it is not just for goods vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: All vehicles with a trailer, not only goods

q19753.en: The sign shown indicates slowing lorries.

explain.short: The sign bans vehicles towing a trailer; it says nothing about lorries slowing down.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'in rallentamento' (slowing down) is invented: a red circle forbids.

sceneParams.caption: It bans trailers; nothing about slowing

q19754.en: The sign shown indicates that road trains must keep at least 100 metres apart.

explain.short: The sign bans vehicles towing a trailer; it sets no distance between them.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'distanza di almeno 100 metri' (at least 100 m apart) is invented for this sign.

sceneParams.caption: It bans trailers; no distance rule

q19755.en: Where the sign shown is present, a car towing a boat trailer may pass.

explain.short: A boat trailer is a trailer, so a car towing it is banned.
explain.rule: This sign bans motor vehicles towing a trailer of any kind. A small luggage trailer (carrello-appendice) and articulated buses are allowed.
explain.trap: 'rimorchio per imbarcazione' (boat trailer) is still a 'rimorchio'.

sceneParams.caption: A car with a boat trailer is banned
